title: Croatian Lamb Kebabs
description: A gluten-free and flavorful recipe featuring Croatian lamb skewers. Perfect for a summer evening with friends and family.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, garlic, paprika, salt, and pepper.
Add the sliced red onion and chopped lettuce to the bowl. Toss to coat.
Thread the lamb shoulder onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Brush the lamb with the garlic-paprika mixture, making sure to coat all sides evenly.
Grill the lamb kebabs for 8-10 minutes per side, or until they reach an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C).
Let the lamb rest for 5 minutes before slicing.
Serve the lamb with the grilled onions and lettuce on the side.
